_note: Official GST rate notifications for goods that Munshi's GST lookup cites. Rates in Central Tax (Rate) notifications are CGST; SGST is the same again, so the GST a customer pays is double (IGST equals the total). build_chunks.py downloads these, parses every entry and applies the amendments.

documents.title: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate)
documents.summary: GST rates on goods: Schedules I to VII (CGST 2.5%, 9%, 20%, 1.5%, 0.125%, 0.75%, 14%). Supersedes 1/2017-Central Tax (Rate).
documents.copyOf: Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3(i); digitally signed by the Government of India Press on 2025-09-17

documents.title: Notification No. 10/2025-Central Tax (Rate)
documents.summary: Goods exempt from GST (nil rate). Supersedes 2/2017-Central Tax (Rate).
documents.copyOf: Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3(i)

documents.title: Notification No. 19/2025-Central Tax (Rate)
documents.summary: Amends 9/2025: biris to Schedule II (18% GST); pan masala and tobacco products to Schedule III (40% GST); Schedule VII (28% GST) omitted.

documents.title: Notification No. 01/2026-Central Tax (Rate)
documents.summary: Amends 9/2025: tariff items for beverages under heading 2202 realigned with the Finance Act, 2026 (Schedule I S. Nos. 150-151, Schedule III S. Nos. 2-3).
